name: Cyclora
tagline: Enterprise-grade charging infrastructure for the two-wheel commuter.
positioning: Cyclora operates a managed charging network for e-bikes and scooters, giving individuals and prosumers institutional-grade uptime, billing, and battery health.

hero.h1: The charging network your commute deserves.
hero.sub: Cyclora manages docking, billing, and battery diagnostics for personal e-bikes and scooters — the same reliability standards fleets pay a fortune for, provisioned for one rider.

features.title: Guaranteed uptime docks
features.description: Every Cyclora dock reports live status to our operations center. If a bay faults, we reroute you to the nearest available charger before you arrive.

features.title: Battery health telemetry
features.description: We track charge cycles, cell temperature, and degradation on your registered battery and flag anomalies before they strand you mid-commute.

features.title: Consolidated billing
features.description: One monthly statement across every dock you touch — itemized by session, kilowatt-hour, and location, exportable for expense reimbursement.

features.title: Reserved bays
features.description: Lock a charging window at your home station or office plaza so a bay is waiting when you roll up, verified by license-plate NFC.

features.title: Network coverage
features.description: Over 4,200 managed bays across 38 metro corridors, with new sites audited to the same Cyclora hardware and safety spec.

features.title: Incident response
features.description: A staffed support desk handles disputes, refunds, and hardware faults with a four-hour resolution commitment on every tier.

testimonials.quote: I retired my apartment charging setup entirely. My Cyclora statement replaced three separate app subscriptions and I finally trust the battery report on my cargo bike.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: We equipped our sales riders with Cyclora reserved bays. Downtime on charging complaints dropped to effectively zero and the billing exports drop straight into our expense system.
testimonials.name: Tomas Verhoeven

testimonials.quote: The battery telemetry caught a failing cell two weeks before it would have left me stranded. That single alert paid for a year of the subscription.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand
